_note: Covered regions. expected_trails is a collapse tripwire, self-baselined: the count this build measured on 13 Nov 2026 (California: 14 Nov 2026); the build fails if a region comes in under 50% of it. It is not an independent OSM figure. classics: each name must be found in the region's names.json with a length in len_m (metres), be ranked first by the app's own name search, and have a stored gain within max_err_pct (default 15) of published_ft (one-way headline gain in feet, source given). stored_len_m: range for the stored (stitched) length when it differs from names.json. v1: also publish the frozen old-format copy at trails/ (Washington only). max_err_pct above 15 is a temporary allowance and only goes with a known_bug note; remove both when the stitcher is fixed.

classics.name: Dog Mountain Trails
classics.known_bug: known stitcher bug: chain starts away from the trailhead; remove when the stitcher is fixed
classics.detail: The stitched chain is 6.89 mi, the published loop length, but it dips to river level (the trailhead) mid-chain, adding a 1,128 ft up-and-down leg; trailhead to summit alone is 2,621 ft (-6.4%). Not DEM noise.

classics.name: Eagle Creek Trail
classics.note: Trailhead to Wahtum Lake: 1,500 ft over the first 7 miles plus 2,250 ft over the next 5, per that guide (sources vary).

classics.name: Misery Ridge
classics.note: Loop figure (5.09 mi, 700 ft); other guides give 910 to 1,100 ft for the ridge climb.

classics.name: Mist Trail
classics.note: Happy Isles to the top of Nevada Fall (the OSM relation ends there): 2.7 mi one way and 1,900 ft per that page, which cites the National Park Service. Gain to the top of Vernal Fall alone is about 1,000 ft.

classics.name: Baldy Bowl Trail
classics.note: Mount San Antonio (Mount Baldy) by the Ski Hut route from the trailhead above Manker Flats: 4.5 mi and 3,900 ft one way, per that page. OSM names it Baldy Bowl Trail (USFS 7W02). Devils Backbone Trail was tried first and dropped: the OSM chain covers only the ridge above the Notch (3.1 km, 1,604 ft stored), not the 2,350 ft the guides give from the Notch. The OSM line is 4.8 km (3.0 mi) against the guide's 4.5 mi, so only the gain is compared. Matt Davis Trail (Mount Tamalpais) was also tried and dropped: its stitched chain is 6 km, no published figure matches it.

classics.name: Steep Ravine Trail
classics.note: Mount Tamalpais State Park, from Pantoll: 3.96 mi out and back with 1,079 ft of gain, so about that much descent one way. Chosen for Mount Tamalpais; the Matt Davis Trail did not match any published figure.
